method: NAIVE. Straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Silver Support Scheme Act 2015 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 December 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/SSSA2015.txt

checks.command: l4 run sss-cases.l4 ; l4 run sss-administration-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 6 to 19. sss-act.l4 has eligibility (s 6 and its four deeming rules), benefits (s 7), recovery (s 10), the offence (s 11) and the power to order repayment on conviction (s 12). sss-administration.l4 has the information regime that makes an automatic means-tested scheme possible - compelled disclosure between departments (s 8) and the limits on what may then be done with it (s 9) - together with the administrator's certificate (s 13), the information powers and obstruction offence (ss 14-15), attribution to officers and partners (s 16), composition (s 17) and protection from personal liability (s 19). NOT ENCODED: ss 1-5, s 18 and s 20. The prescribed eligibility criteria under s 6(1)(c) and every benefit amount remain facts supplied; the regulations were not retrieved.
